rules.quote: Back down sets are 20-25% lighter than your top set.
If you beat the total rep goal on a rest pause set, add weight the following week.

roleTargets.quote: every working set goes to muscle failure within the listed rep range, top sets and back down sets both.

restRules.quote: Rest 3-4 minutes after a top set before the back down set.

warmups.quote: Do 1-3 warm up sets of no more than 6-8 reps before each exercise, never anywhere near failure.

checkInSchedule.quote: every other week for now, on Thursday when you wake up, with everything in by 9am Central.
